cc:Work.dc:title: 91 large ships reach West Sacramento, 156 km from the entrance: 12% of the 743 seen at the entrance
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of the Sacramento River route cells shaded by distinct large ships, and a step chart of ships against distance from the entrance; 743 ships at the entrance and 91 at West Sacramento.
